001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
004import java.lang.ref.WeakReference;
005import java.util.ArrayList;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Objects;
008import java.util.Optional;
009import java.util.Queue;
010import java.util.ServiceLoader;
011import java.util.UUID;
012import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue;
013import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
014import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
015import java.util.function.Consumer;
016import java.util.function.Function;
017import java.util.function.Supplier;
018
019import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
020
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.RootRouter;
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router;
023import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
024
025//@formatter:off
026/**
027 * The main entry point and configuration of RainbowGum logging.
028 * <p>
029 * RainbowGum logging loads configuration through the service loader. While you can
030 * manually set RainbowGum using {@link #set(Supplier)} it is better to register
031 * implementations through the ServiceLoader so that RainbowGum will load prior to any
032 * external logging.
033 * <p>
034 * To register a custom RainbowGum:
035 *
036 *
037{@snippet class="snippets.RainbowGumProviderExample" region="provider" :
038
039class RainbowGumProviderExample implements RainbowGumProvider {
040
041        @Override
042        public Optional<RainbowGum> provide(LogConfig config) {
043
044                Integer bufferSize = config.properties() //
045                        .forKey("logging.custom.async.bufferSize")
046                        .ofInt()
047                        .or(1024)
048                        .validateNow(RainbowGumProviderExample.class);
049
050                LogProvider<LogOutput> output = (name, cfg) -> cfg.properties()
051                        .forKey("logging.custom.output")
052                        .ofProvider(LogOutput::of)
053                        .or(LogOutput.ofStandardOut())
054                        .validateNow(RainbowGumProviderExample.class)
055                        .provide(name, cfg);
056
057                var gum = RainbowGum.builder() //
058                        .route(r -> {
059                                r.publisher(PublisherFactory //
060                                        .async() //
061                                        .bufferSize(bufferSize) //
062                                        .build());
063                                r.appender("console", a -> {
064                                        a.output(output);
065                                });
066                                r.level(Level.INFO);
067                        })
068                        .build();
069
070                return Optional.of(gum);
071        }
072
073}
074}
075 * <p>
076 * <strong>Initialization order</strong> - most of the actual work happens in
077 * {@link LogConfig.Builder#build()}, {@link LogRouter.Router.Builder}, and
078 * {@code LogAppenderRegistry}; this is the exact sequence for anyone debugging a
079 * configuration or writing a {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider.RainbowGumProvider}:
080 * <ol>
081 * <li>{@link LogConfig.Builder#build()} builds the shared {@link LogConfig}:
082 * <ol>
083 * <li>Resolve the {@link ServiceRegistry} (default: a new empty one) and
084 * {@link LogProperties} - manually added
085 * {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider.PropertiesProvider}s, else (if a
086 * {@link java.util.ServiceLoader} was supplied) SPI-discovered ones, with system
087 * properties always layered in as a final fallback. Providers receive a temporary
088 * {@link LogAlerts} collector.</li>
089 * <li>Build {@link LogAlerts} and {@link LogMetrics} from properties.</li>
090 * <li>Build the global level resolver ({@code logging.level.*} and
091 * {@code logging.group.*}, plus anything added directly on the builder).</li>
092 * <li>Construct the {@link LogConfig} itself and replay provider alerts into its
093 * configured {@link LogAlerts}. This is also where the {@link LogConfig#globals()
094 * globals} are resolved and the default output/encoder/publisher registries are
095 * created.</li>
096 * <li>Run every {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator} (manually added,
097 * then SPI-discovered), highest {@linkplain RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator#priority()
098 * priority} first. A configurator returning {@code false} is retried in a later
099 * pass (see {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider#PASSES}) - useful if it depends on
100 * another configurator running first.</li>
101 * <li>Start {@link LogAlerts} - deliberately last, so a configurator's own alert
102 * listener is already registered before alerts decides whether an unobserved
103 * error should refuse startup.</li>
104 * </ol>
105 * </li>
106 * <li>{@link Builder#build()} builds each named {@link LogRouter.Router} (a single
107 * route named {@value LogProperties#DEFAULT_NAME}, unless {@code logging.routes}
108 * names several) via {@link LogRouter.Router.Builder}'s own (package-private)
109 * {@code build()}:
110 * <ol>
111 * <li>Resolve route flags ({@code logging.route.<name>.flags}).</li>
112 * <li>Build a route-scoped level resolver: anything configured directly on the
113 * route builder, layered over {@code logging.route.<name>.level.*}, falling back
114 * to the global level resolver from step 1 (skipped entirely if the route flag
115 * {@code IGNORE_GLOBAL_LEVEL_RESOLVER} is set) - and finally to {@code INFO} if
116 * nothing at all resolves a level.</li>
117 * <li>Resolve appenders - only if none were added programmatically on the route
118 * builder (that check is all-or-nothing: adding even one appender in code skips
119 * property-based resolution entirely). See <strong>Appender resolution</strong>
120 * below.</li>
121 * <li>Resolve the publisher - {@code logging.route.<name>.publisher.uri}, falling
122 * back to a synchronous publisher if unset.</li>
123 * <li>Hand the resolved appenders to the publisher and register the publisher in
124 * the {@link ServiceRegistry}.</li>
125 * </ol>
126 * </li>
127 * <li>{@link #start()} starts the root router, which starts each route's
128 * publisher, which starts each of its appenders, which starts its output (e.g.
129 * opening a file).</li>
130 * </ol>
131 * <strong>Appender resolution</strong> - the part most often mistaken for a bug,
132 * since no appenders are ever added programmatically in the common case:
133 * <ol>
134 * <li>{@code logging.route.<name>.appenders} names the route's appenders; for the
135 * {@value LogProperties#DEFAULT_NAME} route only, a missing value falls back to
136 * the unprefixed {@code logging.appenders}.</li>
137 * <li>If that is <em>still</em> missing: for the default route only, the list
138 * defaults to {@code [file, console]} if {@code logging.file.name} (or Spring
139 * Boot's convention) is set, otherwise just {@code [console]}. A non-default
140 * route with no appenders configured anywhere is a startup failure, not a silent
141 * no-op.</li>
142 * <li>Each named appender then resolves independently. {@code file} and
143 * {@code console} are the two built-in special cases, each with its own output
144 * property/fallback ({@code logging.file.name} then
145 * {@code logging.appender.file.output.uri} for {@code file};
146 * {@code logging.appender.console.output.uri} falling back to standard-out for
147 * {@code console}). Any other name is fully generic:
148 * {@code logging.appender.<name>.output.uri}/{@code .encoder.uri}/{@code .flags}/
149 * {@code .type}, with the output's own URI scheme choosing which registered
150 * {@link LogOutput.OutputProvider} builds it.</li>
151 * <li>An output can supply its own encoder by implementing
152 * {@link LogOutput.ProvidesEncoder} (rare, e.g. some structured outputs): with
153 * {@link LogOutput.ProvidesEncoder.Policy#MANDATORY} that encoder is used as-is
154 * and the {@code .encoder.uri} property is never consulted (configuring one anyway
155 * is a startup failure); with {@link LogOutput.ProvidesEncoder.Policy#DEFAULT}
156 * it is only a fallback and the {@code .encoder.uri} property, if set, still wins.
157 * An output that does not implement {@link LogOutput.ProvidesEncoder} at all is
158 * unaffected: the {@code .encoder.uri} property (or the registry's default for the
159 * output's type) always applies.</li>
160 * </ol>
161 */
162//@formatter:on
163@SuppressWarnings("InvalidInlineTag")
164public sealed interface RainbowGum extends AutoCloseable, LogEventLogger {
165
166        /**
167         * Gets the currently statically bound RainbowGum and will try to load and find one if
168         * there is none currently bound. <strong> This is a blocking operation as in locks
169         * are used and will block indefinitely till a gum has loaded. </strong> If that is
170         * not desired see {@link #getOrNull()}.
171         * @return current RainbowGum or new loaded one.
172         */
173        public static RainbowGum of() {
174                return RainbowGumHolder.get();
175        }
176
177        /**
178         * Gets the currently statically bound RainbowGum or <code>null</code> if none are
179         * <strong>finished binding</strong>. Unlike {@link #of()} this will never load or
180         * start an instance but rather just gets the currently bound one. It will also never
181         * block and does not wait if one is currently being loaded.
182         * @return current RainbowGum or <code>null</code>
183         */
184        public static @Nullable RainbowGum getOrNull() {
185                return RainbowGumHolder.current();
186        }
187
188        /**
189         * Provides the service loader default based RainbowGum.
190         * @return RainbowGum.
191         */
192        public static RainbowGum defaults() {
193                return RainbowGumServiceProvider.provide();
194        }
195
196        /**
197         * Creates a RainbowGum that will <strong>ALWAYS</strong> use the global router.
198         * @param config config.
199         * @return rainbow gum that always uses global router.
200         */
201        public static RainbowGum queued(LogConfig config) {
202                return new SimpleRainbowGum(config, LogRouter.global(), UUID.randomUUID());
203        }
204
205        /**
206         * Sets the global default RainbowGum. The supplied {@link RainbowGum} must not
207         * already be started.
208         * @param supplier the supplier will be memoized when {@linkplain Supplier#get()
209         * accessed} and {@link RainbowGum#start()} will be called.
210         */
211        public static void set(Supplier<RainbowGum> supplier) {
212                RainbowGumHolder.set(supplier);
213        }
214
215        /**
216         * Subscribes to notification of a new RainbowGum becoming the globally bound one (see
217         * {@link #set(Supplier)}, {@link #set(RainbowGum)}, {@link Builder#set()}). This is
218         * primarily for components like SLF4J's logger factory that are themselves
219         * bootstrapped once (often before "the real" RainbowGum has loaded, e.g. a
220         * framework's own pre-boot sequence) and otherwise have no way of finding out that a
221         * different RainbowGum has since replaced the one they captured.
222         * <p>
223         * Only a {@linkplain java.lang.ref.WeakReference weak reference} to
224         * <code>consumer</code> is retained, so subscribing does not by itself keep the
225         * consumer (or whatever it is attached to) reachable - the caller is responsible for
226         * keeping a strong reference to <code>consumer</code> for as long as it needs to keep
227         * receiving notifications, otherwise it may silently stop being called once garbage
228         * collected.
229         * @param consumer called with the newly bound global RainbowGum. Never called while
230         * any RainbowGum internal lock is held.
231         */
232        public static void onGlobalChange(Consumer<RainbowGum> consumer) {
233                RainbowGumHolder.globalChangePublisher.add(consumer);
234        }
235
236        /**
237         * Sets a Rainbow Gum and provides a supplier that will start it globally.
238         * @param gum that will be set immediatly.
239         * @return supplier that will set, get and start the supplied gum and if it is not the
240         * same will throw {@link IllegalStateException}.
241         */
242        public static Supplier<? extends RainbowGum> set(RainbowGum gum) {
243                UUID instanceId = gum.instanceId();
244                RainbowGum.set(() -> gum);
245                return () -> {
246                        var of = RainbowGum.of();
247                        /*
248                         * TODO this is a hack. The holder lock should be used to make this not
249                         * happen.
250                         */
251                        if (!instanceId.equals(of.instanceId())) {
252                                throw new IllegalStateException("Another rainbow gum registered itself as the global. "
253                                                + "This is rare reace condition and probably a bug");
254                        }
255                        return of;
256                };
257        }
258
259        /**
260         * The config associated with this instance.
261         * @return config.
262         */
263        public LogConfig config();
264
265        /**
266         * The router that will route log messages to publishers.
267         * @return router
268         */
269        public RootRouter router();
270
271        /**
272         * Starts the rainbow gum and returns it. It is returned for try-with usage
273         * convenience.
274         * @return the started RainbowGum.
275         */
276        default RainbowGum start() {
277                router().start(config());
278                var debugMode = config().debugMode();
279                if (debugMode == LogConfig.DebugModeType.ALL || debugMode == LogConfig.DebugModeType.HELP) {
280                        var report = config().reporter().report();
281                        MetaLog.error(LogEventFactory.of(RainbowGum.class.getName())
282                                .eventNoArg(Level.INFO, "Rainbow Gum started:\n" + report, null));
283                }
284                if (config() instanceof DefaultLogConfig c) {
285                        var check = c.unusedKeyCheck();
286                        if (check != null) {
287                                reportUnusedKeys(check);
288                        }
289                }
290                if (config().alerts() instanceof DefaultLogAlerts alerts) {
291                        try {
292                                alerts.finishStartup();
293                        }
294                        catch (RuntimeException e) {
295                                close();
296                                throw e;
297                        }
298                }
299                return this;
300        }
301
302        /*
303         * By default an unused key with a suggestion is almost always a typo, so it is a
304         * warning, which logging.alerts.fail=warning (and logging.debug=help) turns into a
305         * failure. One without is only information: the key may be for a component type that
306         * was not chosen, such as encoder options left behind by a profile that switches
307         * encoder. logging.alerts.unusedKey raises both for strict configurations.
308         */
309        private void reportUnusedKeys(UnusedKeyCheck check) {
310                var eventFactory = LogEventFactory.of(LogConfig.class.getName());
311                var unusedKeyLevel = config().alerts() instanceof DefaultLogAlerts alerts ? alerts.unusedKeyLevel()
312                                : LogAlerts.UnusedKeyLevel.INFO;
313                for (var u : check.unused()) {
314                        var level = unusedKeyLevel.level(u.suggestion() != null);
315                        var event = eventFactory.eventNoArg(level, u.message(), null);
316                        config().alerts().alert(event);
317                        if (level == Level.INFO && config().debugMode().checksUnusedKeys()) {
318                                MetaLog.error(event);
319                        }
320                }
321        }
322
323        /**
324         * Unique id of rainbow gum instance.
325         * @return random id created on creation.
326         */
327        public UUID instanceId();
328
329        /**
330         * Will close the RainbowGum and all registered components as well as removed from the
331         * shutdown hooks. If the rainbow gum is set as global it will no longer be global and
332         * replaced with the bootstrapping in memory queue. {@inheritDoc}
333         */
334        @Override
335        public void close();
336
337        /**
338         * This append call is mainly for testing as it does not avoid making events that do
339         * not need to be made if no logging needs to be done. {@inheritDoc}
340         */
341        @Override
342        default void log(LogEvent event) {
343                var r = router().route(event.loggerName(), event.level());
344                if (r.isEnabled()) {
345                        r.log(event);
346                }
347        }
348
349        /**
350         * Use to build a custom {@link RainbowGum} which will use the {@link LogConfig}
351         * provided by the service loader.
352         * @return builder.
353         */
354        public static Builder builder() {
355                ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider> loader = ServiceLoader.load(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class);
356                var config = RainbowGumServiceProvider.provideConfig(loader);
357                return builder(config);
358        }
359
360        /**
361         * Use to build a custom {@link RainbowGum} with supplied config.
362         * @param config the config
363         * @return builder.
364         * @see #builder()
365         */
366        public static Builder builder(LogConfig config) {
367                return new Builder(config);
368        }
369
370        /**
371         * Use to build a custom {@link RainbowGum} with supplied config.
372         * @param config consumer that has first argument as config builder.
373         * @return builder.
374         * @see #builder()
375         * @apiNote this method is for ergonomic fluent reasons.
376         */
377        public static Builder builder(Consumer<? super LogConfig.Builder> config) {
378                var b = LogConfig.builder();
379                config.accept(b);
380                return builder(b.build());
381        }
382
383        /**
384         * RainbowGum Builder.
385         */
386        public class Builder {
387
388                private final LogConfig config;
389
390                private final List<Router> routes = new ArrayList<>();
391
392                private Builder(LogConfig config) {
393                        this.config = config;
394                }
395
396                /**
397                 * Adds a router.
398                 * @param route a router.
399                 * @return builder.
400                 */
401                public Builder route(Router route) {
402                        bind();
403                        this.routes.add(route);
404                        return this;
405                }
406
407                /*
408                 * Routers provision outputs/appenders into the config as soon as they are built,
409                 * so the config must be claimed before that, not just at build().
410                 */
411                private void bind() {
412                        ((DefaultLogConfig) config).bind(this);
413                }
414
415                /**
416                 * Adds a route by using a consumer of the route builder.
417                 * @param name name of router.
418                 * @param consumer consumer is passed router builder. The consumer does not need
419                 * to call {@link Router#builder(String,LogConfig)}
420                 * @return builder.
421                 * @see io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Builder
422                 */
423                public Builder route(String name, Consumer<Router.Builder> consumer) {
424                        bind();
425                        var builder = Router.builder(name, config);
426                        consumer.accept(builder);
427                        return route(builder.build());
428                }
429
430                /**
431                 * Adds a route by using a consumer of the route builder.
432                 * @param consumer consumer is passed router builder. The consumer does not need
433                 * to call {@link Router#builder(String,LogConfig)}
434                 * @return builder.
435                 * @see io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Builder
436                 */
437                public Builder route(Consumer<Router.Builder> consumer) {
438                        bind();
439                        var builder = Router.builder(Router.DEFAULT_ROUTER_NAME, config);
440                        consumer.accept(builder);
441                        return route(builder.build());
442                }
443
444                /**
445                 * Builds an un-started {@link RainbowGum}.
446                 * @return an un-started {@link RainbowGum}.
447                 */
448                public RainbowGum build() {
449                        return build(UUID.randomUUID());
450                }
451
452                /**
453                 * Builds an un-started {@link RainbowGum}.
454                 * @param instanceId unique id for rainbow gum instance.
455                 * @return an un-started {@link RainbowGum}.
456                 */
457                private RainbowGum build(UUID instanceId) {
458                        ((DefaultLogConfig) config).markBuilt(this);
459                        var routes = this.routes;
460                        var config = this.config;
461                        if (routes.isEmpty()) {
462                                var routeNamesResult = config.properties() //
463                                        .forKey(LogProperties.ROUTES_PROPERTY)
464                                        .ofList()
465                                        .or(List.of());
466                                List<String> routeNames = routeNamesResult.validateNow(Builder.class);
467                                /*
468                                 * Validated as a plain list of names, before any of them is used to build
469                                 * a Router, so a bad name is reported against this list property itself,
470                                 * not deferred until some unrelated {name}-keyed property (e.g. this
471                                 * route's own level) happens to interpolate it first.
472                                 */
473                                LogProperty.Validator.validateNames(LogRouter.class, "route", routeNamesResult, routeNames);
474                                if (routeNames.isEmpty()) {
475                                        routes = List.of(Router.builder(Router.DEFAULT_ROUTER_NAME, config).build());
476                                }
477                                else {
478                                        routes = routeNames.stream().map(n -> Router.builder(n, config).build()).toList();
479                                }
480                        }
481                        var root = InternalRootRouter.of(routes, config);
482                        config.changePublisher().subscribe(c -> {
483                                root.changePublisher().publish(root);
484                        });
485                        ((DefaultLogConfig) config).reporter().bind(root);
486                        return new SimpleRainbowGum(config, root, instanceId);
487                }
488
489                /**
490                 * Builds, starts and sets the RainbowGum as the global one picked up by logging
491                 * facades.
492                 * @return started and set rainbow that can be used in a try-close.
493                 */
494                public RainbowGum set() {
495                        UUID instanceId = UUID.randomUUID();
496                        RainbowGum.set(() -> build(instanceId));
497                        var gum = RainbowGum.of();
498                        /*
499                         * TODO this is a hack. The holder lock should be used to make this not
500                         * happen.
501                         */
502                        if (!instanceId.equals(gum.instanceId())) {
503                                throw new IllegalStateException("Another rainbow gum registered itself as the global. "
504                                                + "This is rare reace condition and probably a bug");
505                        }
506                        return gum;
507                }
508
509                /**
510                 * Removes the currently set Rainbow Gum which will close it if one exists and
511                 * will be replaced by the default provision process if {@link RainbowGum#of()} is
512                 * called before {@link #set()}.
513                 * @apiNote This is largely an internal detail for unit testing the provision
514                 * process.
515                 */
516                public void unset() {
517                        RainbowGumHolder.remove(null);
518                }
519
520                /**
521                 * For returning an optional for the LogProvider contract.
522                 * @return optional that always has a rainbow gum.
523                 * @apiNote this method is for ergonomics.
524                 */
525                public Optional<RainbowGum> optional() {
526                        return Optional.of(this.build());
527                }
528
529                /**
530                 * For returning an optional for the LogProvider contract.
531                 * @param condition condition to check if this rainbow gum should be used.
532                 * @return optional rainbow gum.
533                 * @apiNote this method is for ergonomics.
534                 */
535                public Optional<RainbowGum> optional(Function<? super LogConfig, Boolean> condition) {
536                        var cond = condition.apply(config);
537                        if (cond) {
538                                return Optional.of(this.build());
539                        }
540                        return Optional.empty();
541                }
542
543        }
544
545}
546
547final class RainbowGumHolder {
548
549        /*
550         * TODO perhaps a StampedLock would be better performance wise.
551         */
552        private static final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
553
554        private static Supplier<RainbowGum> supplier = RainbowGumServiceProvider::provide;
555
556        private static volatile @Nullable RainbowGum rainbowGum = null;
557
558        static final GlobalChangePublisher globalChangePublisher = new GlobalChangePublisher();
559
560        /*
561         * Lock free read for per event hot paths (see KeyValuesContributor.global()) where
562         * possibly seeing the previous gum while another one binds is harmless.
563         */
564        static @Nullable RainbowGum peek() {
565                return rainbowGum;
566        }
567
568        static @Nullable RainbowGum current() {
569                if (lock.readLock().tryLock()) {
570                        try {
571                                return rainbowGum;
572                        }
573                        finally {
574                                lock.readLock().unlock();
575                        }
576                }
577                return null;
578        }
579
580        static RainbowGum get() {
581                lock.readLock().lock();
582                try {
583                        var r = rainbowGum;
584                        if (r != null) {
585                                return r;
586                        }
587                }
588                finally {
589                        lock.readLock().unlock();
590                }
591                if (lock.writeLock().isHeldByCurrentThread()) {
592                        throw new IllegalStateException("RainbowGum component tried to log too early. "
593                                        + "This is usually caused by dependencies calling logging.");
594                }
595                RainbowGum newlyStarted = null;
596                lock.writeLock().lock();
597                try {
598                        var r = rainbowGum;
599                        if (r != null) {
600                                return r;
601                        }
602                        r = supplier.get();
603                        start(r);
604                        rainbowGum = r;
605                        newlyStarted = r;
606                        return r;
607
608                }
609                finally {
610                        lock.writeLock().unlock();
611                        /*
612                         * Published outside of the write lock so a subscriber can never deadlock or
613                         * trip the "tried to log too early" reentrancy guard above by, say, trying to
614                         * read a volatile field it owns - it is not calling back into this class.
615                         */
616                        if (newlyStarted != null) {
617                                globalChangePublisher.publish(newlyStarted);
618                        }
619                }
620
621        }
622
623        static boolean remove(@Nullable RainbowGum gum) {
624                lock.writeLock().lock();
625                try {
626                        var original = rainbowGum;
627                        if (gum != null) {
628                                if (original != gum) {
629                                        return false;
630                                }
631                        }
632                        /*
633                         * Reset the global router
634                         */
635                        if (original != null) {
636                                LogRouter.global().close();
637                        }
638                        rainbowGum = null;
639                        supplier = RainbowGumServiceProvider::provide;
640                        return true;
641                }
642                finally {
643                        lock.writeLock().unlock();
644                }
645        }
646
647        static void set(Supplier<RainbowGum> rainbowGumSupplier) {
648                Objects.requireNonNull(rainbowGumSupplier);
649                if (lock.writeLock().isHeldByCurrentThread()) {
650                        throw new IllegalStateException("RainbowGum component tried to log too early. "
651                                        + "This is usually caused by dependencies calling logging.");
652                }
653                lock.writeLock().lock();
654                try {
655                        rainbowGum = null;
656                        supplier = rainbowGumSupplier;
657                }
658                finally {
659                        lock.writeLock().unlock();
660                }
661        }
662
663        private static void start(RainbowGum gum) {
664                Objects.requireNonNull(gum);
665                ShutdownManager.addShutdownHook(gum);
666                gum.start();
667                InternalRootRouter.setRouter(gum.router());
668        }
669
670}
671
672/*
673 * Unlike LogConfig.ChangePublisher/LogRouter.RouteChangePublisher (both scoped to a
674 * single RainbowGum/router instance and torn down with it) this is a JVM-lifetime static
675 * registry, so consumers are held only weakly - otherwise every SLF4J logger factory (or
676 * any other subscriber) ever created over the life of the JVM, e.g. across many
677 * short-lived RainbowGums in tests, would be pinned forever.
678 */
679final class GlobalChangePublisher {
680
681        private final Queue<WeakReference<Consumer<RainbowGum>>> consumers = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
682
683        void add(Consumer<RainbowGum> consumer) {
684                consumers.add(new WeakReference<>(consumer));
685        }
686
687        void publish(RainbowGum gum) {
688                for (var it = consumers.iterator(); it.hasNext();) {
689                        var consumer = it.next().get();
690                        if (consumer == null) {
691                                it.remove();
692                        }
693                        else {
694                                consumer.accept(gum);
695                        }
696                }
697        }
698
699}
700
701final class SimpleRainbowGum implements RainbowGum, Shutdownable {
702
703        private final LogConfig config;
704
705        private final RootRouter router;
706
707        private final AtomicInteger state = new AtomicInteger(0);
708
709        private final UUID instanceId;
710
711        private static final int INIT = 0;
712
713        private static final int STARTED = 1;
714
715        private static final int CLOSED = 2;
716
717        public SimpleRainbowGum(LogConfig config, RootRouter router, UUID instanceId) {
718                super();
719                this.config = config;
720                this.router = router;
721                this.instanceId = instanceId;
722        }
723
724        @Override
725        public LogConfig config() {
726                return this.config;
727        }
728
729        @Override
730        public RootRouter router() {
731                return this.router;
732        }
733
734        @Override
735        public RainbowGum start() {
736                int current;
737                if ((current = state.compareAndExchange(INIT, STARTED)) == INIT) {
738                        return RainbowGum.super.start();
739                }
740                throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot start. This rainbowgum is " + stateLabel(current));
741        }
742
743        @Override
744        public UUID instanceId() {
745                return this.instanceId;
746        }
747
748        @Override
749        public void close() {
750                if (state.compareAndSet(STARTED, CLOSED)) {
751                        RainbowGumHolder.remove(this);
752                        try {
753                                shutdown();
754                        }
755                        finally {
756                                ShutdownManager.removeShutdownHook(this);
757                        }
758                        return;
759                }
760        }
761
762        @Override
763        public void shutdown() {
764                router().close();
765                config().alerts().close();
766                config().serviceRegistry().close();
767        }
768
769        @Override
770        public String toString() {
771                return "SimpleRainbowGum [instanceId=" + instanceId + ", config=" + config + ", router=" + router + ", state="
772                                + stateLabel(state.get()) + "]";
773        }
774
775        private static String stateLabel(int state) {
776                return switch (state) {
777                        case INIT -> "created";
778                        case STARTED -> "started";
779                        case CLOSED -> "closed";
780                        default -> {
781                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("" + state);
782                        }
783                };
784        }
785
786}
